prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
A cute flat 2D cartoon sticker illustration of a very chubby, round, pear-shaped cat sitting upright, drawn in a simple meme-emoji style with thick smooth dark-brown outlines and flat pastel colors. Its body is soft butter-yellow and almost spherical, with a big round belly that is slightly lighter cream. It has a large round head that merges into the body with no visible neck, small triangular cat ears, and three little pointed tufts of fur on top of its head. It has short stubby arms, tiny rounded feet, a short curved tail, and a few thin whiskers on each cheek.

The cat is laughing hysterically. Its head is tilted slightly back, its eyes are squeezed into tiny upward-curved crescent lines, and its mouth is stretched into a huge wide-open grin showing a pink tongue and a dark red mouth interior with no sharp teeth. Its cheeks are puffed up with small pink blush ovals, and a tiny tear of laughter sits at the corner of one eye. One paw is pressed against its belly and the other is raised and shaking, as if it is cracking up uncontrollably.

The overall look is silly, goofy, and adorable, like a reaction sticker. It is centered in the frame against a plain solid white background, with a subtle soft shadow beneath it, and there is no text.
